rationale: C08 is the strongest drafting-template candidate because it reproduces the child's full distinctive structure and sequence: the three Railway Labor Act predicates, the thirty-day reporting requirement, the section 10 status-quo provision, and then the additional section 502 Defense Production Act compliance clause. C06 and C16 contain nearly identical machinery and concern airline disputes, but place the section 502 clause before the section 10 provision, unlike the child and C08.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Trans World Airlines, Inc., a carrier and certain of its employees represented by the Flight Engineers' International Association, TWA Chapter, a labor organization
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Pullman Company, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Order of Railway Conductors of America, a labor organization
shared_material.explanation: The same party-and-union recital is reused with the carrier and labor organization replaced.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.explanation: This operative reporting provision is essentially verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Trans World Airline, Inc., or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, to change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Pullman Company or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: Despite apparent transcription omissions in both texts, the same section 10 status-quo mechanism and language appear in the same operative position.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In performing its functions under this order the Board shall comply with the requirements of section 502 of the Defense Production Act of 1950, as amended.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In performing its functions under this order the Board shall comply with the requirements of section 502 of the Defense Production Act of 1950, as amended.
shared_material.explanation: This distinctive additional compliance clause is identical and follows the status-quo provision in both directives.
